description_en: Queries a traffic control task to retrieve its highest-exposure items or invalid items
description_zh: 流量调控曝光排名物品/失效物品查询
kebab_example: aliyun airec list-flow-control-task-item-reports --instance-id airec-cn-0000 --task-id 1666854493104 --select-time-type yesterDay --select-type invalidItem --count 5 --api-version 2020-11-26 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListFlowControlTaskItemReports

parameters.help_en: The ID of the traffic control task
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The time range to query. If selectType is set to invalidItem, only yesterDay is supported.

Valid values:

yesterDay: Yesterday.

lastSevenDays: The last 7 days.

lastFifteenDays: The last 15 days
parameters.help_zh:
查询时间段，如果selectType=invalidItem，则只支持yesterDay。

取值：

yesterDay：昨天。

lastSevenDays：最近7天。

lastFifteenDays：最近15天
parameters.name: select_time_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of data to query.

Valid values:

topExposeItem: Items with the highest exposure.

invalidItem: Invalid items
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据类型。

取值：

topExposeItem：曝光排名物品。

invalidItem：失效物品
parameters.name: select_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of items to query. The default value is 10.
If selectType is topExposeItem, this parameter specifies the number of top items.
If selectType is invalidItem, this parameter specifies the number of invalid items
parameters.help_zh:
当selectType="topItem"，count 代表查询TOP前xx个物品，默认10
当selectType="invalidItem"，count 代表查询失效物品个数，默认10个
parameters.name: count

accClickPercent.description_en: The cumulative percentage of clicks on the item

accItemClick.description_en: The cumulative number of clicks on the item

accItemCtr.description_en: The cumulative CTR of the item

accItemPv.description_en: The cumulative number of exposures of the item

accPvPercent.description_en: The cumulative percentage of exposures of the item

accTaskClick.description_en: The cumulative number of clicks for the task

accTaskCtr.description_en: The cumulative CTR of the task

accTaskPv.description_en: The cumulative number of exposures of the task

clickPercent.description_en: The percentage of clicks on the item for the day

itemClick.description_en: The number of clicks on the item for the day

itemCtr.description_en: The click-through rate (CTR) of the item for the day

itemPv.description_en: The number of exposures of the item for the day

pvPercent.description_en: The percentage of exposures of the item for the day

taskClick.description_en: The number of clicks for the task for the day

taskCtr.description_en: The CTR of the task for the day

taskId.description_en: The ID of the traffic control task

taskPv.description_en: The number of exposures of the task for the day

taskRank.description_en: The exposure ranking for the day
